newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares flat as activity unwinds.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares flat as activity unwinds.

text.p: Norwegian shares were mainly flat in moderate activity on Monday as players packed up for the seasonal holidays.
Oslo's Total share index edged up 0.2 percent to close at 943.30 points in turnover of 658 million crowns.
"It's a non-event day today," said one broker. "Nobody's doing anything ahead of Christmas, there won't be much going on now until the New Year."
The Oslo bourse is closed until Friday, December 27.
Shipbuilding and engineering group Kvaerner was the best performer of the day after it announced two major contracts.

Kvaerner said its German paper and pulp subsidiary Bison had won contracts worth 400 million crowns in Thailand and Canada. It later announced it had signed a 650 million crown letter of intent for upgrading an exploration rig in Baku, Azerbaijan, together with Den norske stats oljeselskap and British Petroleum.
Kvaerner's A stock ended nine crowns up at 298 crowns in trade worth 52.5 million crowns. The B share advanced 8.50 crowns to 265 crowns.
